claim: Patchline ships a multi-year sustainability endowment with a published, funded maintenance budget. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the funded maintenance claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make sustainability-endowment-budget-gate`.
